hooks.name: Create Feature Branch on Task Start
hooks.description: When a spec task is about to start, create and switch to a feature branch (if not already on one) named after the current spec/feature, following the feature/<short-description> convention.

action.command: sh -c 'input=$(cat); branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$branch" ]; then echo "Not a git repository; skipping branch creation." >&2; exit 0; fi; case "$branch" in feature/*) echo "Already on feature branch: $branch"; exit 0;; esac; if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet; then :; else echo "Working tree has uncommitted changes on $branch. Commit or stash before starting a new feature branch." >&2; exit 2; fi; slug=$(printf "%s" "$input" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]" | sed -E "s/[^a-z0-9]+/-/g; s/^-+//; s/-+$//" | cut -c1-40); [ -z "$slug" ] && slug="new-feature"; new="feature/$slug"; if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$new"; then git switch "$new" && echo "Switched to existing branch $new"; else git switch -c "$new" && echo "Created and switched to $new"; fi'
